name: knowledge
description: Turns what a session taught into durable knowledge notes without shallow or misleading ones: triages the session for concepts, systems and mechanisms worth keeping, routes each to confirm (review only, the default), budgeted research in a read-only agent (only with a named reason) or record (what the user stated), checks every sourced claim in a clean-context reviewer, and drafts the note for approval with each fact marked stated, verified or corroborated; --deepen corroborates an existing note later. Store-agnostic (plain markdown by default, Basic Memory or any MCP-backed store by config) and source-agnostic (code, docs, tickets, web — whatever the project declares or has connected). Also ships /knowledge:detour: when a concept or API blocks understanding of a PR or codebase, you say what is unclear, the session interviews you on the code to find where it blurs, and helps you map what must be understood (base concepts, how the pinned technology models them, how the repo uses them, a short picture of the project, and comprehension targets tied to the code), then packages it as a handoff for an agent that already knows you, which teaches and challenges as it sees fit; --return reopens the code where you stopped.
